configuration.initialization: Every new layer independently loads the same 50k AWGN score; new activity output and log calibrations are zero.

receiver.selection: Mean final-layer conditional-channel loss + BCE; epoch0 eligible; earliest tie.
receiver.extensions: Accepted general-A damped messages; independent pretrained first scores and activity heads; three independent scalar calibrations; no second score.

feedback_damping.scope: Feedback only; current layer score, channel mean and activity logits unchanged

configuration.scope: Ten layers; explicit nineteen formal conditions; known phase/noise; independent physical scenes; no independent test or automatic ablation.

objective.channel: true-active conditional squared error / fixed training mean scene energy
objective.activity: summed natural-proportion BCE / fixed training mean users

configuration.seed_policy: New disjoint physical scene seeds; initialization and epoch-order rules inherited from v2.
configuration.condition_design: Union of four one-variable sweeps; default appears once; no Cartesian product.

execution_acceleration.graph_scope: score backbone only; single total-loss backward; eager diagnostics and evaluation
